title: The shopping list
instructions: Anna ve Tim markette telefonla konuşuyor. Alınacak ve alınmayacak şeyleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: tim
script.text: Hi Anna, I'm at the supermarket. What do we need?

script.speaker: anna
script.text: We need milk, eggs and bread.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: Twelve. No, six is fine. We don't eat a lot of eggs.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: No, we have cheese. But we don't have any butter.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: Yes, please, but not the expensive one. The small one is OK.

script.speaker: tim
script.text: There isn't any brown bread. Is white bread OK?

script.speaker: anna
script.text: Yes, white is fine. Oh, and buy some flowers for my mum. It's her birthday tomorrow.

questions.prompt: How many eggs does Tim buy?
questions.feedback: Anna önce on iki der, sonra altı (six is fine) yeterli der.

options: There isn't any in the shop.

questions.feedback: Pahalı olanı değil, küçük olanı (The small one) istiyor.
Kepekli (brown) ekmek yok; beyaz ekmek (white bread) alıyor.
Çiçekler Anna'nın annesi için; yarın onun doğum günü.
